gloss: dropping formalities; party without rank distinctions

definitions.gloss: dropping formalities; setting aside rank; party where everyone is equal
definitions.explanation: A gathering where the usual hierarchical etiquette between seniors and juniors is temporarily suspended, allowing everyone to relax and enjoy themselves as equals. Common at company drinking parties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無礼講|ぶれいこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}きましょう→行く：00119_iku⟧。

⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「{無礼講|ぶれいこう}だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{気楽|きらく}→気楽：07159_kiraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The department head said 'no formalities tonight,' so everyone started drinking in a relaxed manner.

examples.japanese: 「{無礼講|ぶれいこう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦タメ{口|ぐち}→タメ口：16740_tameguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}ったら→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Even if they say 'no formalities,' you'd be in big trouble if you actually used casual speech with your boss.

notes:
USAGE:
{無礼講|ぶれいこう} literally means "no-rudeness lecture" — a gathering where rudeness (breaking rank) is permitted. It is commonly declared at company ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking parties) and ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧ (year-end parties).

IMPORTANT CULTURAL NOTE:
In practice, {無礼講|ぶれいこう} is often a polite fiction. While the boss may declare the gathering {無礼講|ぶれいこう}, employees are still expected to maintain a degree of respect. Truly dropping all formality with superiors can still cause problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無礼講|ぶれいこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go with no formalities)
- {無礼講|ぶれいこう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to declare it a no-formalities event)
- ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無礼講|ぶれいこう} (tonight there are no formalities)
